Julie — thanks for sending this over and for the details. A few quick items so we can complete setup and issue a PO:

- Because BrightCloud is US-based, we require a completed W-9 (Form 2020 or current). Please attach a signed PDF that includes your legal business name exactly as registered and the EIN you provided.
- We also need a remittance address and confirmation of preferred invoice email (AP contact).
- I'll loop in Finance to validate the EIN and create the PO; typical turnaround is 2 business days after the completed W-9 is received.

For your convenience, I've attached our vendor onboarding checklist with the exact fields that must be present on the W-9 to avoid extra rounds. If you prefer, you can upload the signed W-9 to our vendor portal: https://procurement.redwood.com/vendor-portal/onboard

Attachments: VendorOnboardChecklist.pdf (checklist of required fields and example signed W-9)

Best,
Lauren Bishop
